title: Models on disk: safetensors and families
hook: Build and damage a safetensors file by hand, watch a pickle run code, and see how ComfyUI tells SD 1.x from SDXL by reading three shapes from a header.

verified.claim: load_torch_file uses load_safetensors when DynamicVRAM is active and safe_open otherwise for .safetensors and .sft, and torch.load with weights_only=True for the rest.
load_safetensors raises these two messages, and the safe_open route adds them only when the library's error holds the names HeaderTooLarge or MetadataIncompleteBuffer.

On the safe_open route with safetensors 0.9.0-rc.1, a cut file and an absurd header length gave the library's own words, without ComfyUI's added text. The library also refused a hole, a wrong shape and a numeric metadata value.
verified.ref: comfy.utils.load_torch_file on damaged files, on a CPU

verified.claim: SD15 expects a context of 768, and SDXL a context of 2048 and an extra vector of 2816. matches compares every listed entry.
A file that matches no family is tried as a diffusion model, then reported.
The file, the damage tests and the pickle demonstration come from running the lab.
The layout follows the safetensors README, Format section.

unchecked: The lab's matcher is a tiny stand-in. We did not load real SD 1.5 and SDXL files for this lesson; the shapes are those the family classes list.
We read the load_safetensors route in the source and did not run it, because comfy-aimdo was not initialised in our CPU test.
